## Trigger Budget Review
n8n opens a review ticket, asks the Budget Agent's policy service (POST /api/policy/review) to evaluate the proposed terms against budget_rules.yaml, and returns the decision.
If the policy service is unreachable, 'ok' is false and the orchestrator falls back to its local copy of the same policy - the demo never stalls.
**Extend it:** add a Slack/Email node after 'Policy check' to ping a human approver for HIGH-priority tickets.
